channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: SICPA secures major European award for UK Vaping Duty Stamps Program
item.description: SICPA and Cartor will deliver the UK Vaping Duty Stamps Program for HMRC, integrating secure tax stamp printing with advanced digital track-and-trace systems. The initiative aims to strengthen excise duty collection, enhance compliance, and combat illicit trade in vape products.

item.title: TikTok accounts use AI image of Johor exco in BKJ scam
item.description: Police warn of AI-generated scam using Johor exco's image to promote fake BKJ aid, with 12 TikTok accounts detected operating from overseas.

item.title: FAM cancels three tournaments for restructuring and future planning
item.description: Football Association of Malaysia cancels three futsal and beach football tournaments, citing a strategic review to streamline the competition calendar and align with long-term development goals.

item.title: 2026 Volkswagen Golf R-Line Mk8.5 priced from RM 180k in Malaysia, 1.5L mild hybrid, 150hp/250 Nm
item.description: Following the launch of the Golf GTI Mk8 facelift (commonly known as the Mk8.5) in November last year, the 2026 Volkswagen Golf R-Line Mk8.5 is now available in Malaysia, priced at RM 185,990. As part of an early bird offer, the first 50 customers will enjoy RM 6,000 off, bringing the price down to RM 179,990. This price includes the Volkswagen Assurance Package (VAP), which covers five years of free maintenance, a five-year or 150,000 km warranty, and five years of roadside assistance.

item.title: Sabah to meet all waste management criteria before November transfer
item.description: Sabah ensures nine criteria, including legal and technical frameworks, are met before assuming full control of scheduled waste management in November.

item.title: VinFast Middle East signs MoU with PlusX Electric to strengthen EV ownership experience in the UAE
item.description: VinFast Middle East has partnered with PlusX Electric to enhance EV ownership in the UAE. The collaboration focuses on expanding charging access, emergency roadside support, and digital integration, reinforcing a reliable and customer-centric electric mobility ecosystem across the region.

item.title: Russia investigates Telegram founder Durov for alleged terror links
item.description: Russia's FSB is investigating Telegram founder Pavel Durov for allegedly facilitating terrorism, escalating pressure on the popular messaging app.

item.title: RM89 million allocated to boost digital skills for entrepreneurs
item.description: The National Institute of Entrepreneurship allocates RM89 million for a digital training programme to enhance e-commerce skills and business transformation among entrepreneurs.

item.title: Perlis customs seizes RM611,340 in cannabis and vapes
item.description: Royal Malaysian Customs in Perlis foils two smuggling attempts, seizing 20kg of cannabis and 9,400 vape devices with a total value of RM611,340.

item.title: Middle East coffee shops earn spots in The World’s 100 Best Coffee Shops 2026 list
item.description: Coffee shops from the UAE, Qatar, Turkey, and Oman have earned recognition in The World’s 100 Best Coffee Shops 2026. The ranking celebrates global excellence in specialty coffee, highlighting the Middle East’s rising presence in the international café community.
